tagline: Prompt-to-app builders, agentic editors, starter templates, guides and practices for building software by describing it.
scope: It is about building software mainly by describing it to an AI, not a general coding assistant for line-by-line work.
heroAlt: Animated isometric scene: a microphone hears a prompt typed into a speech bubble, sparks fly from the bubble into a phone where a habit tracker app builds itself block by block, then gets a check mark.
